purpose: Blind creative-diversity benchmark. These briefs should produce materially different governing ideas and expressive grammars when the evidence warrants it.

briefs.brief: Launch page for an experimental fashion label releasing 18 asymmetrical garments. Assets: stark studio photography, construction close-ups, designer notes. Primary action: enter the drop/shop. Audience already follows independent fashion.
briefs.mode_collapse_risk: SaaS cards, dashboards, generic dark-tech aesthetic

briefs.brief: Landing page for software that plans robotic welding cells before installation. Evidence: cycle-time simulation, collision checks, CAD screenshots, engineering diagrams. Primary action: book an engineering demo.
briefs.mode_collapse_risk: generic AI glow and abstract network graphics

briefs.brief: Subscription landing page for a family astronomy app for ages 8–12. Evidence: sky missions, telescope guidance, illustrated constellations, parent controls. Primary action: start family trial.
briefs.mode_collapse_risk: premium-minimal editorial stiffness or enterprise UI

briefs.brief: Launch page for a niche fragrance built around wet stone, iris and cold metal. Assets: macro material photography, bottle stills, perfumer notes. Primary action: purchase a limited first edition.
briefs.mode_collapse_risk: dashboard proof, dense explanatory UI, startup language

briefs.brief: Enterprise page for litigation software that reconstructs case chronology from evidence and links every claim to source documents. Evidence: real anonymized case timeline, citation graph, review workflow. Primary action: request demo.
briefs.mode_collapse_risk: generic legal seriousness with stock courthouse imagery

briefs.brief: Homepage for a grid-scale thermal battery company. Evidence: pilot-site photography, charge/discharge curves, modular hardware, deployment map. Audience: utilities and industrial energy buyers. Primary action: talk to deployment team.
briefs.mode_collapse_risk: software-dashboard-first storytelling or vague climate gradients

briefs.brief: Landing page for a three-day neighborhood arts festival across 24 venues. Evidence: poster archive, artist images, venue map, schedule. Primary action: explore program and reserve limited events.
briefs.mode_collapse_risk: corporate event template or single-product hero grammar

briefs.brief: Landing page for a developer runtime that records deterministic execution traces for distributed jobs. Evidence: trace viewer, replay diff, SDK snippets, latency overhead measurements. Primary action: install SDK / read docs.
briefs.mode_collapse_risk: same forensic-instrument aesthetic reused merely because it fits the category

batch_questions: Do the eight outputs have materially different governing ideas when the briefs warrant it?
Do typography, imagery, composition and motion derive from each domain rather than one house style?
Are repeated structures justified by shared usability needs rather than skill-induced defaults?
Could three or more outputs be made interchangeable by swapping logo, copy and palette? If yes, fail creative generalization.
